_readme: Your redirect / referral links live here.
Each entry is a short address on YOUR site that forwards to a longer
referral or affiliate address. Use them in bios, comments, messages,
or on other websites, and every one of them keeps working even if you
Example: https://yourdomain.com/go/youtube points at your offer.
Add entries either by editing this file, or from the command line:
node addlink.js youtube https://example.com/?ref=you "Subscribe on YouTube"
slug    the short name used in the address, letters/numbers/dash only
url     where the visitor is sent
label   a note for yourself, shown only in your private stats page
enabled set to false to switch a link off without deleting it
newTab  true if the link should open in a new tab (used on the site itself)
